description: Post the saved feedback preview under the connected user's public co.build account. The mod's maintainer is notified as for a comment on the website. Requires explicit approval of the exact action and public text. Pass the draftId from prepare_feedback, its unchanged digest and consentVersion (agent-feedback-v1), and approved:true only after that approval. OAuth consent is not approval. Retrying the same draftId never posts twice. An expired draft needs a new preview and approval. Never open GitHub issues or pull requests for feedback.
name: publish_feedback
title: Publish approved feedback
